findings.title: 合法raw DEFLATE的zlib样首字节被错拒
findings.root_cause: 两字节framed启发式单边选decoder，没有合法歧义raw路径
findings.minimal_repro: raw=bytes.fromhex('789c0063ff')+b'A'*156+bytes.fromhex('010000ffff'); zlib.decompress(raw,-15)==b'A'*156; HTTP header content-encoding=deflate; wire chunks step=1/2/166
findings.expected: 完整156B原文成功，仍校验真正标准zlib checksum/EOF/预算
findings.actual: 3个分片均ProviderBudgetStop incomplete_response，底层zlib invalid stored block lengths
findings.remediation_constraint: 有界增量或上限内受控回放；不得向SDK先发未经选定候选正文，不忽略坏标准checksum/EOF/垃圾

findings.title: 完整下载后校验失败的公共CLI遗漏HTTP观察和wire计量
findings.root_cause: 成功读完HTTP后的异常只挂capture_receipt/usage，CLI读取顶层typed属性；早期HTTP失败和晚期import失败不一致
findings.minimal_repro: 真实official_source_cli.main/capture_official_source，MockTransport HTTP200 text/html gzip，请求application/pdf，HTML正文；无任意头和路径泄露
findings.expected: MIME具名拒绝，观察status200/text-html/gzip/wire length unknown及实际wire bytes/completeness投影到失败envelope；未观察头保持unknown
findings.actual: CLI return2，无canonical原件；out['http_observation'] KeyError；内部receipt已有观察和wire
findings.remediation_constraint: 只投影有限typed metadata、保留来源身份/SHA/MIME验真和原费用语义，并覆盖完整后SHA/持久化/校验与recover失败

findings.title: 显式提前关闭异步response不立即关闭已持有的底层iterator
findings.root_cause: iterator局部变量只在__aiter__ finally关闭，aclose没有持有或关闭它；HTTPX提前结束嵌套iterators不会立即执行该finally
findings.minimal_repro: gzip180000B，AsyncClient.stream读首<=65536B输出；退出response context，显式await outer.aiter_bytes().aclose（同一个outer实例），退出client；tracked stream.closed True/iterator_closed False
findings.expected: response显式关闭时stream与其活跃iterator立即收口
findings.remediation_constraint: 幂等close/aclose拥有活跃迭代器，避免重入关闭正在执行generator；未声称真实socket泄漏，现预算/timeout异常清理已PASS

findings.title: handled failed final丢失可选wire completeness false
findings.root_cause: 失败final只复制http_wire_bytes；_charge_failure_usage按正文/费用complete True重建envelope，未携带独立wire complete标志
findings.expected: 实体9/wire7/费用0.25照常入现budget，公开usage_complete True，但wire_usage_complete False
findings.remediation_constraint: 可选缺/坏wire保持unknown、不新门禁。自管SDK本次未产生该false组合，属诊断兼容遗漏
